joshua.15.p1.b1.text: Now the allotment for the clans of the tribe of Judah extended to the border of Edom, to the Wilderness of Zin at the extreme southern boundary:

joshua.15.p1.b2.text: Their southern border started at the bay on the southern tip of the Salt Sea, proceeded south of the Ascent of Akrabbim …

joshua.15.p1.b3.text: … the border went up the Valley of Hinnom along the southern slope of the Jebusites (that is, Jerusalem) …

joshua.15.p1.b4.text: And the western border was the coastline of the Great Sea. These are the boundaries around the clans of the descendants of Judah.

joshua.15.p2.b1.text: And Caleb drove out from there the three sons of Anak—the descendants of Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai, the children of Anak.

joshua.15.p2.b2.text: To the man who strikes down Kiriath-sepher and captures it, I will give my daughter Acsah in marriage.

joshua.15.p2.b3.text: So Othniel son of Caleb’s brother Kenaz captured the city, and Caleb gave his daughter Acsah to him in marriage.

joshua.15.p3.b1.text: One day Acsah came to Othniel and urged him to ask her father for a field.

joshua.15.p3.b3.text: Give me a blessing … Since you have given me land in the Negev, give me springs of water as well.

joshua.15.p3.b4.text: So Caleb gave her both the upper and lower springs.

joshua.15.p4.b1.text: This is the inheritance of the clans of the tribe of Judah.

joshua.15.p4.b2.text: These were in the wilderness: Beth-arabah, Middin, Secacah, Nibshan, the City of Salt, and En-gedi—six cities, along with their villages.

joshua.15.p4.b3.text: … Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron), and Zior—nine cities, along with their villages.

joshua.15.p4.b4.text: But the descendants of Judah could not drive out the Jebusites living in Jerusalem. So to this day the Jebusites live there among the descendants of Judah.
